subject: crtf-prog
title: CRTF.PROG.------TR.
description: First of two diagrams in BK(NM)-6. The prose immediately below identifies the section's structural target: 'By cross-transfer implications of western art music I am referring to how the progressional solidification of the "actual" music comes about. For history can be viewed with respect to how the spread of given concepts — and practices — were brought about.' The crossing diagrams how creative-progression structurally meets transformation at the cross-transfer-of-progressional-solidification scale: CRTF-PROG (creative progression — the form's actual progressive working) crossed with TR (transformation — the partner-axis's working transformation). CRTF-PROG sits centrally with the subject-arrow; IST-F (isolated focus) at upper-center and TR at top-right with TRS (transformation, lowercase) on the right margin as the partner-side upper outputs. PRI-INFO (principle information) sits at upper-left as bridging upper input. POL-DY (political dynamics) sits at center-right with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and SOC-RT (social reality) below, and MOT-DY (motion dynamics) at the right margin as the partner-side downward chain. PROJ-DY (projection dynamics) anchors the lower-left and RE-ST (restructuralism) at lower-center as the subject-side downward outputs. EXPN (expansion) sits at the bottom-center and LK-IMP (linkage implication) below as the bridging-axis downward terminus. Structural argument: when creative-progression is crossed with transformation, the upper diagonal IST-F → TR → TRS is the *transformation chain* — isolated-focus routes through transformation into its lowercase aspect. PRI-INFO → CRTF-PROG is the bridging upper input — principle-information enters the form's progression. The partner's right-chain POL-DY → PROG-CONT → SOC-RT → MOT-DY converts the form's progression into progressional-continuance, social-reality and motion-dynamics on the partner-side. PROJ-DY → RE-ST → EXPN → LK-IMP is the bridging-bottom chain: projection-dynamics routes through restructuralism into expansion and finally into linkage-implication. The structural argument: the cross-transfer implications the prose names are structurally that the upper diagonal converts the form's principle-information into IST-F's isolated-focus *before* it reaches CRTF-PROG's actual progressive working — and the partner-axis's right-chain converts the result into MOT-DY's terminal motion-dynamics, the form's progressional working absorbed into the receiving culture's motion. The bridging-bottom RE-ST → EXPN → LK-IMP is what creative-progression actually produces — restructuralism, expansion, and linkage-implication; this is the route by which actual progressional solidification operates rather than being absorbed.
